units.source_text: 类似的对话，不时在镜子跟前交换。

en.t: Conversations like this were exchanged from time to time in front of the mirror.

units.source_text: 这张过分奢侈的化妆桌，在科学家的家庭里似乎没有产生丈夫所预期的效果。

en.t: This excessively luxurious dressing table did not seem to have produced the effect the husband had expected in the scientist's household.

units.source_text: 于是有一天，他若无其事地说：

en.t: So one day, he said as if nothing were the matter:
